dataset.retained: Paraphrased relevant aggregate/statistical notes only; original HTML outside repository.
notes: Dataset page identifies August 2026 as latest available; the 15 September release refers to the 13 August claimant reference day.
The next listed 20 October release is confirmed with a 10 September reference day. A calendar item is not evidence that data have been published.
The page states releases usually occur at 7am. No reliable API timestamp timezone declaration was found.

methodology.retained: Paraphrased relevant aggregate/statistical notes only; original HTML outside repository.
notes: NM_162_1 combines Jobseeker's Allowance and relevant Universal Credit claimants; it is not an unemployment estimate.
Figures are rounded independently to the nearest five, so separately published totals need not add exactly.
Universal Credit data can lead to revision of the preceding month; more extensive methodology revisions remain possible.
